faq.q: What do I get for free?
faq.a: Create an eligible new account to receive a one-time allowance for 5 dish results. This is not a recurring allowance or an automatically renewing subscription trial.

faq.q: Does one menu use one allowance?
faq.a: Your allowance counts dish results, not menu photos. For example, with 5 dishes remaining, a menu with 6 dishes can show 5 opened results and a locked sixth result.
You can explore the app before signing in. An account is required to claim the free dish allowance and begin scanning.

faq.q: What happens to unused monthly dishes?
faq.a: Monthly allowances reset with the subscription period. Unused allowance does not roll over.

faq.q: Can I revisit results after my subscription ends?
faq.a: Yes. Your previously opened results remain accessible after your subscription expires. Opening new results requires available allowance.

faq.q: Where do I subscribe or restore a purchase?
faq.a: Subscriptions and purchase restoration are handled inside the iPhone app. You can manage or cancel an Apple subscription through your Apple account settings.

faq.q: Can I rely on the app for allergies?
faq.a: Dish information and images are for discovery and may not match the restaurant’s preparation. Confirm ingredients, allergens and dietary needs directly with the restaurant.

support.title: How can we help?
support.body: Tell us what happened and which version of the app you are using. Please do not send passwords, payment details or sensitive photos.
